threads.body: @trask looks like we currently don't test pre 2.17 versions but the instrumentation seems to work since 2.0. Supported libraries has `2.11+`

replies.body: Support for Log4j 2.0+ was introduced in #5979, which changed the Muzzle range from [2.11.0,) to [2.0,) and replaced MapMessage.forEach() with getData().forEach(), adding the TODO addressed here.

> looks like we currently don't test pre 2.17

this was done to avoid people flagging the repo for log4shell

> Supported libraries has 2.11+

probably should change this to 2.17+

Thanks for the context, @trask. I removed the tests for older Log4j versions and kept the pre-2.9 fallback. A Log4j 2.17 unit test now verifies that we capture MapMessage attributes without calling getData().

threads.body: [Testing] The new capability check and fallback are not exercised on pre-2.9 Log4j: the library tests use 2.17, and the shared testing dependency brings Log4j API 2.17 into agent tests. Add an installed-agent suite with matching pre-2.9 API/core dependencies that logs a `MapMessage` and asserts its exported attributes. This should verify helper loading and fallback execution when the newer API is absent, which Muzzle checks alone cannot establish.

replies.body: Agreed that neither the 2.17 test nor Muzzle exercises the pre-2.9 fallback at runtime. We removed the older-version suite because we intentionally avoid pre-2.17 Log4j test dependencies to avoid Log4Shell scanner flags. Let's keep the fallback and the 2.17 fast-path test without reintroducing those dependencies.
